SONAR

A brand film for sound you can almost feel through the screen.

ROLE

Edit, Sound & Motion

PROJECT TYPE

Independent concept

YEAR

2026

FOCUS

Brand Film / Sound

SONARFEEL EVERY FREQUENCY.
01 / THE STARTING POINT

Make technical performance feel immediate.

Audio products have a lot to explain: materials, comfort, sound quality, everyday usability. The edit turns that depth into feeling—building in waves instead of dropping a wall of specifications.

Made for listeners who see their headphones as part of their daily world—from a focused work session to the walk home.

“You don’t need to hear the product to feel its personality.”
THE EDITING PRINCIPLE
02 / THE DIRECTION

Give the film a rhythm of its own.

Cobalt, chrome and sharp lime accents set a confident tone. The timeline moves between full-product hero moments and quieter beats, giving the film contrast and pace.

  • Start with a feeling, then support it with useful detail.
  • Cut motion to the beat so features land as moments.
  • Keep the product and the next decision visible throughout.

Confident / Rhythmic

Large, direct framing and compact titles create a clear rhythm. Saturated colour carries the energy while the sound design carries the pace.

03 / THE EDIT

A clear path.
A distinct feeling.

The film builds in three movements: meet the product, feel the listening experience, explore the details. Sound design and transitions support that order rather than competing with it.

WHAT THE FILM BRINGS TOGETHER

Edit & pacing

A cut built on the beat, with contrast between hero moments and detail.

Sound design

Music edit, layered sound, and a mix that lands every transition.

Motion graphics

Kinetic titles and animated product callouts that stay on message.

04 / THE TAKEAWAY

A note for
the next cut.

Motion works best when it has a job. Giving each transition a clear purpose creates more impact than keeping everything moving all the time.

This is an independent concept. It presents the intended edit and visual direction, rather than results from a commissioned campaign.
